manifest.description: Minimal local inventory of the document library. One JSON object. sha256/size must be measured from the real files; mtime is the file mtime in ISO-8601 UTC (weak version evidence, see merge_playbook.md).

files.relpath: path relative to the library root, forward slashes, unique
files.sha256: lowercase hex digest of the file bytes

page_texts.description: Extracted page texts live in a directory tree, not a JSON file: texts/<filekey>/page-NNN.txt, UTF-8, where filekey = relpath with '/' replaced by '__' and NNN is the 1-based zero-padded page number. Scripts normalize page text (lowercase, whitespace collapsed) before matching; all reported char offsets refer to the NORMALIZED page text.

annotations.description: JSONL, one object per line. file is the manifest relpath of the version the annotation was taken on; file_sha256 pins the exact bytes.

format.anchored_text: verbatim quoted text the annotation is anchored to
format.contents: the annotation body written by the reader

fields.nodes: [{relpath, sha256, size, mtime, stem}] sorted by relpath
fields.edges: [{type, from, to, evidence}] sorted by (type, from, to). type byte_duplicate: same sha256 AND same basename; renamed_copy: same sha256, different basename (evidence.sha256); version_of: different sha256, same normalized stem, text similarity >= 0.6, directed older->newer by mtime (evidence.normalized_stem, evidence.text_similarity = character 5-gram Jaccard over normalized concatenated page texts, evidence.older_mtime/newer_mtime, evidence.direction_basis).
fields.clusters: [{cluster_id, members, canonical, canonical_rule}]; canonical = newest mtime, ties broken by shortest relpath then lexicographic order
fields.metadata_conflicts: [{type: suspected_mislabel|similarity_unavailable, files, stem, text_similarity, reason}] — same normalized stem but no version_of edge
fields.uncertainty: list of strings; always includes the mtime-is-weak-evidence note
fields.degraded: list of strings; non-empty => process exited 3

migration_report.format: JSONL, one record per input annotation, sorted by annotation_id. Annotations are never merged; every record keeps annotation_id, source.file_sha256 and target.file_sha256.

record.contents: copied from input (verbatim, enables conflict detection)
record.status: native (already on the canonical member) | migrated (ratio >= 0.9) | shifted (0.7 <= ratio < 0.9) | orphaned (ratio < 0.7, kept on source version) | error (processing failed)
record.target: null for orphaned/error, else {file, file_sha256, page, char_start, char_end} with offsets into the NORMALIZED canonical page text; char_start/char_end may be null when offsets could not be computed for a native record
record.ratio: best SequenceMatcher ratio, rounded to 4 decimals; 1.0 for native; null for error
record.warnings: optional list, e.g. annotation file_sha256 disagrees with the manifest

fields.read_only: sorted relpaths the case rules mark untouchable (from --read-only)
fields.clusters: [{cluster_id, canonical, aliases, alias_policy, annotation_counts: {status: n}, conflict_queue}]
fields.conflict_queue: [{canonical_page, region_index, region_char_span, overlap_char_span, annotations: [{annotation_id, source_file, contents}], reason}] — annotations from DIFFERENT source versions whose target spans overlap on the same canonical page region while contents disagree; grouped for human review, never auto-resolved
fields.annotations_outside_graph: count of migration records whose source file is in no cluster
fields.requires_human_review: [{kind: conflict|shifted|orphaned|error, cluster_id, annotation_ids, reason}]; empty list means fully automatic
fields.fully_automatic: boolean, true iff requires_human_review is empty
